Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: natural photographic desktop wallpaper.
Image 1 is the edit target. Keep its BEAUTIFUL ORIGINAL COMPOSITION: the broad white sand dune curve in the lower left, turquoise blue water filling the right, clean blue sky in the top half, distant dune horizon. Keep those three strong large color shapes and the quiet negative space; do not replace it with an ordinary grassy coastline. No logo.
Change the physical textures and weather treatment so it convincingly resembles an actual professional photograph of Brazilian white-sand dunes and a seasonal lagoon: sand is finely grainy with slight unevenness, remove the exaggerated repetitive fabric-like foreground ridges; break the too-perfect geometric dune crest slightly; restrained natural ripples in the water, natural muted turquoise near shore and deeper blue farther out; the clouds should be ordinary irregular soft-edged cumulus, not exaggerated towering stacked cloud sculptures.
Natural daylight exposure, physically coherent shadows, gentle atmospheric haze at distant horizon, realistic photographic contrast, less cyan saturation, subtle restrained warm sand highlights. Detailed but not artificially sharp everywhere. Photographic, unretouched editorial landscape aesthetic. Preserve the elegant simple sweep and original visual design.
Avoid: CGI, plastic, glowing water, fake HDR, airbrushing, patterned fabric sand, cloud towers, extreme sharpness, over-saturation, grass-cluttered foreground, people, UI, text, logo, watermark. Target 3840x2160 landscape16:9.

Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: SandCore white Aurora theme desktop logo wallpaper, landscape16:9, target3840x2160.
Image1 is a SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY for the new SandCore two dune crest strokes and round core. Use that simple two-wave silhouette, but discard its glow and shading entirely.
Create an understated, beautifully composed brand wallpaper. Soft pearl-white background with very pale ice-blue atmospheric shading across the bottom and upper-left, almost white. ONE compact FLAT SandCore emblem, right of center around (68% width,47% height), 18% of image width. The two dune strokes have crisp edges and a uniform tasteful deep muted teal fill; the core is a small flat sand-gold circle. Clean negative space between the shapes. No perspective, no 3D thickness, no bevels, no metallic material, no glass, no radial halo behind the mark.
A single extremely subtle broad translucent pale-blue sweep crosses the lower third of the background. It supports the composition and never intersects or wraps around the emblem. Large quiet left area for icons. Elegantly restrained design with very strong brand silhouette and deliberate proportions, the quiet design confidence of a beloved classic OS wallpaper.
Do not use turbines, crystals, diamonds, ornaments, sparkle, neon, large glowing blobs, glossy objects, lensflare, chrome or detailed render effects. No text, letters, watermark or Windows logo. ONE finished wallpaper, not a logo sheet or mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: SandCore Classic theme pixel-art logo wallpaper, an original restrained Windows 95 era desktop wallpaper homage.
Image1 is a reference ONLY for the simple SandCore logo silhouette: two broad dune crests with round golden core. Make a deliberately low-color BITMAP PIXEL ART version of that identity. The user rejects glossy true-color retro imagery and asks for a visibly nostalgic pixel wallpaper.
Canvas16:9. Art intended for a 640x360 indexed bitmap, visibly crisp square pixel steps, no antialiasing, exactly a restrained 16-color appearance. Flat Windows95-style dark teal background (#008080 style) with a quiet sparse diagonal repeat pattern of tiny darker teal dunes, large quiet left side for desktop icons.
On the right-center: a compact 90s-style pixel SandCore dune emblem, two blocky stepped cyan/ivory dune bands enclosing a small stepped sand-gold circle. Small two-pixel gray/navy drop shadow, very modest two-tone embossed shading, hand-pixelled crisp silhouette, about20%of canvas width. Nostalgic, simple, graphic and thoughtfully spaced. The curves MUST have deliberately visible stair-stepped pixel edges and flat color bands.
No glossy metal, transparent glass, glowing core, turbine, diamond, photorealism, continuous smooth gradients, 3D rendering, light ribbons, bloom, vignette or excessive texture. No words, text, lettering, Microsoft logo, UI or watermark. Single finished authentic-looking early-PC indexed-color wallpaper.
